title: Express Fundamentals
definition: Express.js is a minimal and flexible Node.js web application framework that provides a robust set of features for web and mobile applications.
simpleExplanation: Raw Node.js HTTP is like building a house with a handsaw and a hammer; it takes forever. Express is a team of contractors with power tools. It handles all the tedious plumbing—like parsing URLs, sending JSON, and handling errors—so you can focus purely on writing the actual business logic of your app.
realWorldExample: It is the 'E' in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node). It powers the backend of massive platforms like Twitter, Uber, and IBM.

intermediate: What is the main `app` object in Express?

answers.question: Is it built in?
answers.answer: No. It is a 3rd party package. You must run `npm install express`.

answers.question: What is the app object?
answers.answer: It is an instance of Express. You use it to define routes (`app.get`), configure middleware (`app.use`), and start the server (`app.listen`).
